scope: Juice Box: independently reviewed numbered EPUB observations, with wiki used only as a discovery lead. Form-dependent displayed levels are story facts, never numeric level measurements.
knownGaps: No trustworthy true level or complete base-stat display found.
No source-confirmed death found; departure is not treated as death.
No separately tracked equipped item confirmed in this audit.
Shapeshifting and possession labels describe demonstrated abilities rather than named, leveled skill notifications.

events.subject: Juice Box
events.name: Character introduced
events.summary: Juice Box is introduced as a changeling at the Toe inn.

events.subject: Juice Box
events.name: Shapeshifting
events.summary: Juice Box changes between Ratkin and Mouser forms. This describes an observed ability; no numeric skill level is stated.

events.subject: Juice Box
events.name: Form-dependent displayed level
events.summary: Her human form displays level 35. The narration explicitly warns that her displayed level changes with her form and does not reveal her true level.

events.subject: Juice Box
events.name: Blank-form displayed level
events.summary: Her blank form displays level 120. Her true level remains unknown; this is not a confirmed level increase.

events.subject: Juice Box
events.name: The Unwashed form
events.summary: Juice Box demonstrates a form identified as the Unwashed, also called the Beautiful Place.

events.subject: Juice Box
events.name: Dynastes form
events.summary: Juice Box appears as a large armored dynastes with scythes.

events.subject: Juice Box
events.name: Hunter Wraith form
events.summary: Juice Box transforms into a Hunter Wraith.

events.subject: Juice Box
events.name: Possession (Hunter Wraith)
events.summary: A system message confirms Juice Box controls Louis through wraith possession. This ability is demonstrated in Hunter Wraith form; no skill level is stated.

events.subject: Juice Box
events.name: Fleshmancer form
events.summary: Juice Box changes form after being asked to become a Fleshmancer and requests medical supplies.

events.subject: Juice Box
events.name: Departure from the realm
events.summary: A system message confirms Juice Box has left the realm and forfeited her warlord position. This does not confirm her death.

events.subject: Juice Box
events.name: Departure through the Nothing
events.summary: The narration confirms Juice Box entered the Nothing. Her destination and survival are not confirmed at this point.
